zh: 邻居家的狗每天晚上都叫个不停。
en: The neighbours' dog {barks} every night.

zh: 我们把所有的厨余都拿去堆肥。
en: We {compost} all our food scraps.

zh: 太阳太晒，花都蔫了。
en: The flowers {wilted|drooped} in the heat.

zh: 冬天是修剪果树的最佳时候。
en: Winter is the best time to {prune|trim} the fruit trees.

zh: 他给玫瑰喷了杀虫剂。
en: He {sprayed} the roses with insect spray.

zh: 我用树皮给菜园做了一层覆盖。
en: I {mulched} the vege garden with bark.

zh: 种子已经发芽了。
en: The seeds have {sprouted|germinated}.

zh: 丰盛湾的农民种植猕猴桃。
en: Farmers in the Bay of Plenty {cultivate|grow} kiwifruit.

zh: 这里的樱花九月开。
en: The cherry trees here {blossom|bloom|flower} in September.

zh: 刺猬在冬天会冬眠。
en: Hedgehogs {hibernate} over the winter.

zh: 农场工人们正在给羊剪毛。
en: The farm workers are {shearing|clipping} the sheep.

zh: 猫冲着狗发出嘶嘶的声音。
en: The cat {hissed} at the dog.

zh: 小鸡终于孵出来了。
en: The chicks have finally {hatched}.

zh: 奶牛正在围场里吃草。
en: The cows were {grazing} in the paddock.

zh: 他每天早上五点挤牛奶。
en: He {milks} the cows at five every morning.

zh: 新西兰圣诞树开花了，说明圣诞节快到了。
en: The pohutukawa trees are {blooming|flowering}, so Christmas must be close.

zh: 我们家的母鸡每天下一个蛋。
en: Our hen {lays} an egg every day.

zh: 她专门繁育边境牧羊犬。
en: She {breeds} border collies.

zh: 植物在干旱中都枯萎了。
en: The plants {withered|died|shrivelled|shriveled} in the drought.

zh: 我们在后院用陷阱抓到了一只负鼠。
en: We {trapped|caught} a possum in the backyard.

zh: 今天早上鸟儿在外面叽叽喳喳地叫。
en: The birds were {chirping|singing|tweeting} outside this morning.

zh: 她轻轻地抚摸着猫。
en: She gently {stroked|petted} the cat.

zh: 牧羊犬正在把羊赶进羊圈。
en: The farm dogs were {herding|driving|moving} the sheep into the yard.

zh: 我们上周收获了第一批西红柿。
en: We {harvested|picked} our first tomatoes last week.

zh: 春天应该给柠檬树施肥。
en: You should {fertilise|fertilize|feed} the lemon tree in spring.

zh: 在花园里跪了一整天，我膝盖好疼。
en: My knees hurt after {kneeling} in the garden all day.

zh: 这个周末我得修剪一下树篱。
en: I need to {trim|cut|prune} the hedge this weekend.

zh: 霜冻把我的番茄苗冻死了。
en: The frost {killed} my tomato plants.

zh: 狗凑过来闻了闻我的鞋。
en: The dog {sniffed|smelled|smelt} my shoes.
